Search normalized lobbying names and candidate equivalences

eulob_search_normalized.Rd

Searches original lobbying registrations using a conservative nominal matching method or an expanded exploratory method.

Usage

eulob_search_normalized(
  query,
  method = c("strict", "exploratory", "both"),
  limit = 100L,
  min_similarity = 0.88,
  candidate_filter = c("focused", "all")
)

Arguments

query

A single non-empty organization name.

method

One of "strict", "exploratory" or "both".

limit

Maximum number of name records to return.

min_similarity

Minimum similarity for exploratory fuzzy candidates, from 0 to 1.

candidate_filter

Use "focused" to prioritize lexical matches, or "all" to preserve all exploratory candidates.

Details

Strict mode includes exact name matches, documented registration aliases and highly conservative orthographic candidates. Exploratory mode also includes fuzzy and shared-prefix candidates. The both option returns the expanded results with their matching levels identified. No method verifies common legal identity.

Value

A data frame retaining the original country, register, lobby identifier and name, with matching evidence, similarity and review indicators.
